title: GIG-4072: Restore Parent Auth Json After Pre Start Before Compose Up
description: Overwrite-seeds parent auth.json before worktree up and restores it again after pre_start so container composer install uses the parent Nova login, not a leftover .env account.

test_plan.description: Worktree composer install uses parent Nova auth after pre_start rewrites it
steps: Confirm the parent checkout has a working auth.json for nova.laravel.com
In a worktree, let pre_start write a different .env Nova account into auth.json
Confirm ngramx restores the parent file before docker compose up
Confirm container composer install authenticates as the parent account

test_plan.description: Leftover worktree auth.json is replaced before up
steps: Leave a worktree auth.json that uses the .env Nova account
Re-run ngramx worktree for that ticket
Confirm the worktree auth.json username matches the parent before containers start
